fields.purpose: County inspectors file reports on paper and retype them at the office, which delays permits by a week on average. This project gives them a mobile app that works offline and files the report on the spot.
fields.background: Three counties asked for this in the 2026 survey. A 2024 attempt stalled on **offline support**, which is now solved by the sync work in the shared platform.
fields.objectives:
- Cut the time from inspection to filed report from 6 days to 1
- Retire the paper form in the two pilot counties
- Keep the app usable with no signal for a full day
fields.scope:
- The inspector app: forms, photos, signatures, offline sync
- Report export to the permit system
- Training for the two pilot counties
fields.out_of_scope:
- Changes to the permit system itself
- Counties beyond the pilot until the pilot review in March
fields.deliverables:
1. The inspector app in both app stores
2. Export to the permit system
3. A training kit for county staff
fields.success_criteria: Both pilot counties file 90% of inspections in the app by the end of February, with no lost reports.
fields.constraints: The permit system's API is read-only until its upgrade in Q2, so export goes through the nightly import.
fields.budget: Two engineers and a designer for six months; hosting within the existing platform budget.
